compiled_state.description:
Captured 2026-08-30 as the deferred "Option B" from Decision 4 (nginx-edge cluster). Idea/undesigned — needs its own design + ADR before promotion.

## Context
ADR 0079 (autodeploy-on-box-timer, from story 8903 gall-plume-adder) deliberately scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container ONLY; Gerrit config (CONFIG_PATHS) is DETECT-ONLY (signal via AUTODEPLOY_ERROR, never auto-applied) because auto-applying config to a box hosting a live FAIL-CLOSED submit gate is high-risk. ADR 0079 names "config auto-apply" as an explicit deferred v2. The nginx edge (`infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template`) is in the SAME deferred bucket.

Bug 1d1b (downy-feminist-leopard) is being fixed under Option A (detect-and-signal only): add the edge template to a detect-only manifest so a merged edge change raises AUTODEPLOY_ERROR for an operator to apply, closing the SILENT-failure defect without expanding the unattended auto-apply surface. This idea is the follow-on: make autodeploy actually render + validate + reload the edge unattended.

## Why this is a design project, not a bug fix
- Blast radius spans every port-443 surface (MCP, /review/, /opcert/, Gerrit) including the submit gate — a bad reload could freeze all submissions.
- Needs: template render step, `nginx -t` validation, atomic reload, rollback-to-prior-conf on failure (deployed-sha not advanced), and the ADR 0079 stability constraints (bounded blast radius = never touch the gerrit container; self-heal; SHA-keyed backoff; flock serialisation).
- OSS precedent to weigh: Argo CD makes auto-sync opt-in per-app with explicit automated-rollback/self-heal toggles (drift DETECTION is always on; APPLY is deliberate); Terraform separates plan (detect) from apply (mutate); ingress controllers gate reload behind `nginx -t`. Design should mirror that "detect always, apply as a deliberate, separately-designed step" posture.

## Scope sketch (to be designed)
- NGINX_PATHS/EDGE_PATHS manifest + render pipeline in autodeploy.sh (infra/scripts/, outside eb64 scope).
- Validate-then-atomic-swap with rollback; leave prior working edge serving on failure.
- Live-validation harness analogous to a61d's AC5 (probe the edge post-deploy).
- ADR amendment/new ADR recording the v1->v2 boundary crossing.

## Relations
Follow-on to 1d1b (downy-feminist-leopard); would fully automate what a61d (enchanting-phantastic-weevil) currently needs an operator deploy for. Discovered-from lineage: 8903 (v1 scoping) -> 1d1b.
compiled_state.title: v2: autodeploy full auto-apply of the nginx edge (render + nginx -t + atomic reload + rollback)
